name: project_history
description: Cross-session retrieval of implementation decisions and negative queries.

memories.title: FibMind agent workflow
memories.content: Query FibMind before non-trivial work, append a concise result after implementation, and record outcomes when evidence confirms or refutes a memory.

memories.title: MCP SDK 2 server API
memories.content: The startup error was fixed by pinning mcp>=2,<3 and importing MCPServer from mcp.server instead of FastMCP from mcp.server.fastmcp.

memories.title: Forget must redact the event log
memories.content: The event log is the source of truth. Forget must tombstone earlier payload content, otherwise replay would resurrect the deleted memory.

memories.title: JSON demo store
memories.content: The example program writes a small disposable JSON memory store for demonstrations.

memories.title: Recall is not evidence
memories.content: Familiarity stays out of relevance ranking. Only confidence changed by a named external outcome is a trust signal.

cases.query: Which MCP SDK version and server import fixed the startup error?
Why must forget redact the event log during deletion?
How is the Kubernetes production deployment configured?
